title: Researchers Use Lasers to Study Ancient Peruvian Mummies
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: For more than 5,000 years, humans have covered themselves with permanent artistic designs known as tattoos.
sentences.zh: 五千年来,人类一直用 被称为纹身的永久艺术设计来覆盖自己。

sentences.en: In a recent study, researchers used lasers to uncover highly complex designs of ancient tattoos on mummies from Peru.
sentences.zh: 在最近的一项研究中,研究人员使用激光技术发现秘鲁木乃伊的古代纹身设计非常复杂。

sentences.en: The skin of the mummies and the black liquid, or ink, used to make the tattoos permitted researchers to observe fine details.
sentences.zh: 木乃伊的皮肤 和黑色液体,或墨水, 用来做纹身, 允许研究人员 观察细细的细节。

sentences.en: These marks are not visible to the human eye, said study co-writer Michael Pittman of the Chinese University of Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 香港中华大学的 Michael Pittman 联合撰稿人说 人类眼中看不到这些痕迹

sentences.en: The researchers examined around 100 mummies dating to around 775 years ago.
sentences.zh: 研究人员检查了大约100个木乃伊, 日期大约是775年前。

sentences.en: The mummies were from coastal Peru’s Chancay culture, which grew and developed before the Inca empire and the arrival of Europeans.
sentences.zh: 这些木乃伊来自秘鲁沿海的Chancay文化,这种文化在印加帝国和欧洲人到来之前成长和发展。

sentences.en: All the individuals had some form of tattoos on the back of their hands, knuckles, arms or other body parts.
sentences.zh: 所有人手背、指关节、手臂或其他身体部位都有纹身。

sentences.en: The study paid careful attention to four individuals with “ exceptional tattoos” — designs of shapes such as triangles and diamonds, said Pittman.
sentences.zh: 皮特曼说,这项研究认真关注了四个“特别纹身”的人——三角形和钻石等形状的设计。

sentences.en: It was not clear how the tattoos were created.
sentences.zh: 并不清楚纹身是如何创造的

sentences.en: But they are “of a quality that stands up against the really good electric tattooing of today,” said Aaron Deter-Wolf of the Tennessee Division of Archaeology.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州考古系的Aaron Duizer-Wolf说,

sentences.en: Deter-Wolf was not involved in the research.
sentences.zh: 阻力-沃夫没有参与研究。

sentences.en: The study results appeared recently in the publication Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences .
sentences.zh: 研究结果最近出现在《国家科学院议事录》的出版物中。

sentences.en: Using lasers that make skin glow , “we basically turn skin into a light bulb ,” said study co-writer Tom Kaye of the nonprofit Foundation for Scientific Advancement based in Sierra Vista, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州Sierra Vista的非盈利性科学进步基金会共同撰稿人Tom Kaye表示:「我们基本上把皮肤变成灯泡。

sentences.en: The findings were “helpful to learn about new non-destructive technologies that can help us study and document sensitive archaeological materials,” such as mummies, said Deter-Wolf.
sentences.zh: Duiz-Wolf说,研究结果“有助于了解有助于我们研究和记录敏感的考古材料的新的非破坏性技术”,如木乃伊。

sentences.en: The oldest known tattoos ever discovered are on the remains of a Neolithic man who lived in the Italian Alps around five thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最古老的纹身 是在五千年前 住在意大利阿尔卑斯山的 一位新石器师的遗骸上发现的

sentences.en: Many mummies from ancient Egypt also have tattoos, as do remains from cultures around the world.
sentences.zh: 许多来自古埃及的木乃伊人也有纹身,世界各地文化的残骸也是如此。

sentences.en: People have used tattooing for many reasons throughout history.
sentences.zh: 历史上人们用纹身有很多原因

sentences.en: The marks can show cultural or individual identity, social standing, and more.
sentences.zh: 这些标记可以显示文化或个人特征、社会地位等等。

sentences.en: Tattoos also have been used for protection against disease or to deepen relationships with spirits or gods, suggested Lars Krutak.
sentences.zh: 据Lars Krutak说,纹身还被用于预防疾病或加深与灵或神的关系。

sentences.en: Krutak, who works at the Museum of International Folk Art in Santa Fe, New Mexico, was not involved in the research.
sentences.zh: 在新墨西哥圣菲国际民间艺术博物馆工作的克鲁塔克没有参与研究。

sentences.en: Designs on ancient textile and stone products are more commonly found in good condition for study than are ancient tattoos.
sentences.zh: 古代纺织品和石制品的设计比古代纹身更常见于良好的学习条件。

sentences.en: But ancient tattoos when studied can provide information about art forms that would not otherwise be available, suggested Martin Smith of Bournemouth University.
sentences.zh: 但古老的纹身在研究时 能够提供否则无法提供的艺术形式信息 伯恩茅斯大学的马丁·史密斯

sentences.en: Smith was not involved in the recent study.
sentences.zh: Smith没有参与最近的研究。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell. Christina Larson reported on this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: Christina Larson为美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: John Russell改编了它 用于VOA学习英语。
